cells.title: External Rotation Stretch
cells.guideText: 1. Sit with your feet pressed against each other, and one knee raised all the way out to the side of your body. 2. Place your elbow on your raised knee, bend it at 90 degrees, and point your hand directly forward, holding your barbell/dumbbell. 3. Keep your shoulder depressed and retracted, raise your hand until your forearm is vertical, as if you were about to wave at someone like a robot. 4. Lower your hand to the original position and repeat.

cells.title: Supine crossed-leg rotation stretch
cells.guideText: Lie on your back. Bend your right knee and bring that leg across the left leg. Extend your left arm out at shoulder height. Use your right hand to guide the bent knee gently toward the floor on your left while keeping your left shoulder down. Breathe comfortably, hold the stretch, and repeat on the other side.
cells.reviewNote: Supine bent knee crosses opposite straight leg, opposite arm extends laterally with shoulder grounded; guiding hand on knee matches clarified rotation stretch.
